notes.title: Animal Portal – Puzzle Leaving the Steam Store
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We want to let you know that Animal Portal – Puzzle[/p][p] will be retired from sale on Steam. If you already own the game, you will still be able to play it from your Steam library, but it will no longer be available for new purchases.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your support and for being part of the community.[/p]

notes.title: V.0.40.0
notes.notes:
🎮 We're thrilled to present a game-changing update for [Animal portal], enhancing the core puzzle experience and immersing players in meticulously crafted environments like never before! Get ready for a gaming journey that's more captivating, challenging, and visually stunning.

🧩 Revamped Puzzles:
Dive into an upgraded puzzle-solving experience! We've fine-tuned existing challenges, introduced new mind-bending puzzles, and incorporated innovative mechanics that will test your skills to the max. Whether you're a seasoned player or a newcomer, prepare for a cerebral adventure like never before.

🌎 Environments Reimagined:
Explore breathtaking environments that have been meticulously redesigned and optimized. From awe-inspiring landscapes to intricate details, every corner of the game world now boasts improved graphics and enhanced aesthetics. Immerse yourself in a captivating visual feast as you navigate through stunning scenes.

🛠️ Bug Squashing Extravaganza:
We've been hard at work addressing your feedback! This update comes with a comprehensive bug fix, resolving issues big and small. Say goodbye to those pesky bugs and glitches, and enjoy a smoother, more polished gaming experience. Your feedback has been invaluable in making Animal portal the best it can be!



🚀 Update Now and Experience the Evolution:
Embark on a thrilling adventure with the enhanced puzzle mechanics, stunning visuals, and a game world free from bugs. Update your game now and prepare to be captivated by the next level of immersive gameplay in [Your Game Title].



Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to see you in the enhanced world of Animal portal!
